newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT lifts Manila shares in early trade.
newsitem.headline: PLDT lifts Manila shares in early trade.

text.p: Philippine stocks climbed in early trade on Thursday, buoyed by Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co's first half profits, traders said.
"It's mainly due to PLDT's earnings and the rise of its ADR in New York," said Allan Araullo, vice-president, Regina Capital Development.
The main index climbed 1.20 percent to 2,626.54 points in early trade. It opened 11.93 points up at 2,607.35.
